text.p: A total of 1.07 million shares in Russian natural gas monopoly RAO Gazprom changed hands in electronic trading on Friday at an average 3,054 roubles ($0.539) a share, up from 2,994 roubles at the previous session on February 19, the Federal Securities Corporation (FFK) said.
Full details of the trading session:
Gazprom is one of Russia's biggest companies by market capitalisation but its 23.6 billion shares are highly illiquid because of company restrictions on selling them.
The company has organised regular auctions and electronic trading sessions to create an orderly market in its paper.
Gazprom was $0.526 at 1150 GMT on Friday on the Russian Trading System, down from $0.560 on Thursday.
Its American Depositary Shares were $19.99 after $19.875. One ADS is equivalent to 10 ordinary shares.
The next electronic trading sessions will be held on February 26, 27, 28 and March 5,6,7,11,12,13,14.
